mapper.sql: SELECT D.*, S.STN_NM, S.STN_SEQ, S.MNLS_STN_YN, L.LINK_SYS_NM, L.PROTCL_CD FROM vw_tnms_gateway_device_live D LEFT JOIN com_stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=D.stn_cd LEFT JOIN web_link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=D.link_sys_cd WHERE 1=1

sql.if: AND (D.device_nm LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR D.device_id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR D.device_ip LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.sql: D.ems_id AS EMS_ID, D.device_id AS SOU_EQPMNT_ID, D.device_id AS GATEWAY_DEVICE_ID, 'Y' AS GATEWAY_MANAGED, D.device_id AS EQPMNT_MNG_NO, D.device_nm AS EQPMNT_NM, D.device_type AS EQPMNT_SE_CD, D.device_type AS EQPMNT_CLSF_NM, D.link_sys_cd AS LINK_SYS_CD, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS LINK_SYS_NM, D.stn_cd AS STN_CD, S.STN_NM AS STN_NM, D.device_station AS INSTL_PLC_NM, D.device_ip AS EQPMNT_IP_ADDR, D.device_model AS EQPMNT_MDL_NM, D.device_maker AS DEVICE_MAKER, D.server_ip AS SERVER_IP, D.device_check AS DEVICE_CHECK, D.device_desc AS EQPMNT_EXPLN, CASE WHEN D.ping_alive=1 AND D.stts_cd NOT IN ('UNKNOWN','OFFLINE') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CNTN_YN, D.stts_cd AS STTS_CD, D.stts_expln AS STTS_EXPLN, D.ping_dt AS LAST_RSPNS_DT, D.ping_dt AS CLCT_DT, D.cpu_usage AS CPU_USGRT, D.memory_usage AS MMRY_USGRT, D.disk_usage AS DISK_USGRT, D.usage_dt AS USAGE_DT, D.usage_fresh_yn AS USAGE_FRESH_YN, D.ping_alive AS PING_ALIVE, D.test_yn AS TEST_YN, 'Y' AS USE_YN

COUNT(D.device_id) AS TOTAL_NOCS, COALESCE(SUM(D.stts_cd='NORMAL'),0) AS NORMAL_NOCS, COALESCE(SUM(D.stts_cd='CAUTION'),0) AS CAUTION_NOCS, COALESCE(SUM(D.stts_cd='CRITICAL'),0) AS CRITICAL_NOCS, COALESCE(SUM(D.stts_cd='OFFLINE'),0) AS OFFLINE_NOCS, COALESCE(SUM(D.stts_cd='UNKNOWN'),0) AS UNKNOWN_NOCS

CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(D.stts_cd='CRITICAL'),0)>0 THEN 'CRITICAL' WHEN COALESCE(SUM(D.stts_cd='CAUTION'),0)>0 THEN 'CAUTION' WHEN COALESCE(SUM(D.stts_cd='OFFLINE'),0)>0 THEN 'OFFLINE' WHEN COALESCE(SUM(D.stts_cd='UNKNOWN'),0)>0 THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN COUNT(D.device_id)>0 THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS STTS_CD
mapper.select: SELECT L.LINK_SYS_CD, L.LINK_SYS_NM, , , MAX(D.ping_dt) AS CLCT_DT FROM web_link_sys_info L LEFT JOIN vw_tnms_gateway_device_live D ON D.link_sys_cd=L.LINK_SYS_CD AND D.ems_id IN #{id} WHERE L.USE_YN='Y' AND L.LINK_SYS_CD IN ('EMS_TX','VMS','PBX','EMS_PIDS','SCADA_SEC') AND L.LINK_SYS_CD IN #{code} GROUP BY L.LINK_SYS_CD,L.LINK_SYS_NM ORDER BY FIELD(L.LINK_SYS_CD,'VMS','PBX','SCADA_SEC','EMS_PIDS','EMS_TX')

SELECT S.STN_CD,S.STN_NM,S.STN_SEQ,S.MNLS_STN_YN, , , MAX(D.ping_dt) AS LAST_CLCT_DT FROM com_stn_info S LEFT JOIN vw_tnms_gateway_device_live D ON D.stn_cd=S.STN_CD AND D.ems_id IN #{id} AND D.link_sys_cd=#{linkSysCd} WHERE S.USE_YN='Y' GROUP BY S.STN_CD,S.STN_NM,S.STN_SEQ,S.MNLS_STN_YN ORDER BY S.STN_SEQ

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY D.ems_id,D.device_id) AS EQPMNT_SN,
FROM vw_tnms_gateway_device_live D LEFT JOIN com_stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=D.stn_cd LEFT JOIN web_link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=D.link_sys_cd WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY COALESCE(S.STN_SEQ,999),D.device_nm,D.device_id

SELECT , ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN D.usage_fresh_yn='Y' THEN D.cpu_usage END),1) AS CPU_USGRT, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN D.usage_fresh_yn='Y' THEN D.memory_usage END),1) AS MMRY_USGRT, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN D.usage_fresh_yn='Y' THEN D.disk_usage END),1) AS DISK_USGRT FROM vw_tnms_gateway_device_live D WHERE 1=1

SELECT 1 AS EQPMNT_SN, FROM vw_tnms_gateway_device_live D LEFT JOIN com_stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=D.stn_cd LEFT JOIN web_link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=D.link_sys_cd WHERE D.ems_id=#{emsId} AND D.device_id=#{deviceId}

SELECT SHA2(CONCAT(D.ems_id,':',D.device_id),256) AS eqpmntSn, D.ems_id AS emsId,D.device_id AS gatewayDeviceId, D.device_id AS eqpmntMngNo,D.device_nm AS eqpmntNm, D.link_sys_cd AS linkSysCd,L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, D.stn_cd AS stnCd,S.STN_NM AS stnNm,D.device_ip AS ipAddr,D.device_type AS eqpmntSeCd, L.PROTCL_CD AS protclCd,D.cpu_usage AS cpuUsgrt,D.memory_usage AS mmryUsgrt, D.disk_usage AS diskUsgrt,D.usage_dt AS lastClctDt,D.stts_cd AS sttsCd, D.ping_dt AS lastPingDt,D.usage_fresh_yn AS usageFreshYn,D.test_yn AS testYn FROM vw_tnms_gateway_device_live D LEFT JOIN web_link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=D.link_sys_cd LEFT JOIN com_stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=D.stn_cd WHERE 1=1 AND SHA2(CONCAT(D.ems_id,':',D.device_id),256)=#{eqpmntSn} ORDER BY D.usage_dt DESC,COALESCE(S.STN_SEQ,999),D.device_nm LIMIT 500

SELECT D.ems_id AS emsId,D.device_id AS gatewayDeviceId, D.device_nm AS eqpmntNm,D.device_id AS eqpmntMngNo, CASE WHEN #{topIndicator}='MMRY_USGRT' THEN D.memory_usage WHEN #{topIndicator}='DISK_USGRT' THEN D.disk_usage ELSE D.cpu_usage END AS value, '%' AS unitNm, CASE WHEN D.usage_fresh_yn='Y' THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS sttsCd, D.usage_dt AS clctDt,D.usage_fresh_yn AS usageFreshYn FROM vw_tnms_gateway_device_live D WHERE D.usage_fresh_yn='Y'
ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT K.perfIdctCd,K.perfIdctNm,'%' AS unitNm, MAX(CASE WHEN D.usage_fresh_yn='Y' THEN D.usage_dt END) AS lastClctDt, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(D.usage_fresh_yn='Y'),0) > 0 THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS sttsCd FROM (SELECT 'CPU_USGRT' AS perfIdctCd,'CPU' AS perfIdctNm UNION ALL SELECT 'MMRY_USGRT','MEMORY' UNION ALL SELECT 'DISK_USGRT','DISK') K LEFT JOIN vw_tnms_gateway_device_live D ON D.ems_id IN #{id} AND D.link_sys_cd=#{linkSysCd} AND D.stn_cd=#{stnCd} GROUP BY K.perfIdctCd,K.perfIdctNm

sql.if: AND D.ems_id=(CASE #{linkSysCd} WHEN 'EMS_TX' THEN 1 WHEN 'VMS' THEN 4 WHEN 'PBX' THEN 11 WHEN 'EMS_PIDS' THEN 13 WHEN 'SCADA_SEC' THEN 16 ELSE -1 END)

AND (G.COM_CD=#{grade} OR G.GW_CD=#{grade} OR CASE D.event_grade WHEN '1' THEN 'EMERGENCY' WHEN '2' THEN 'HIGH' WHEN '3' THEN 'LOW' WHEN '4' THEN 'WARNING' WHEN '5' THEN 'INFO' ELSE 'CLEAR' END=#{grade})
AND (E.device_nm LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR D.device_id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR D.event_msg LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.sql: CONCAT('GW-A-',D.event_seq) AS dsbltyNo,D.event_seq AS eventSeq, D.ems_id AS emsId,D.device_id AS souEqpmntId, E.device_nm AS eqpmntNm, D.device_id AS eqpmntMngNo,E.device_ip AS ipAddr,E.device_type AS eqpmntSeCd, E.device_station AS instlPlcNm,D.event_loc AS dsbltyOcrnPlcNm, D.event_type AS dsbltyTypeNm,D.event_msg AS dsbltyOcrnCn, D.event_grade AS gatewayGrade,D.event_dt AS dsbltyOcrnDt, D.event_yn AS eventYn, CASE D.event_grade WHEN '1' THEN 'EMERGENCY' WHEN '2' THEN 'HIGH' WHEN '3' THEN 'LOW' WHEN '4' THEN 'WARNING' WHEN '5' THEN 'INFO' ELSE 'CLEAR' END AS dsbltyGrdCd, COALESCE(G.COM_CD_NM,D.event_grade) AS dsbltyGrdNm, CASE D.ems_id WHEN 1 THEN 'EMS_TX' WHEN 4 THEN 'VMS' WHEN 11 THEN 'PBX' WHEN 13 THEN 'EMS_PIDS' WHEN 16 THEN 'SCADA_SEC' ELSE '' END AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm,E.stn_cd AS stnCd,S.STN_NM AS stnNm, 'UNCONFIRMED' AS prcsSttsCd,'게이트웨이 수집' AS prcsSttsNm, 'GATEWAY' AS dataSource,'N' AS tempActionYn, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,D.event_dt,NOW()) AS elapsedSec

LEFT JOIN com_device_info E ON E.ems_id=D.ems_id AND E.device_id=D.device_id LEFT JOIN com_stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=E.stn_cd LEFT JOIN web_link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=(CASE D.ems_id WHEN 1 THEN 'EMS_TX' WHEN 4 THEN 'VMS' WHEN 11 THEN 'PBX' WHEN 13 THEN 'EMS_PIDS' WHEN 16 THEN 'SCADA_SEC' ELSE '' END) LEFT JOIN com_cd_info G ON G.COM_CD_GROUP_ID='CD_FALT' AND G.GW_SRC_COL='event_grade' AND G.GW_CD=D.event_grade

AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM web_dsblty_excp_group_eqpmnt_rel M JOIN web_dsblty_excp_group_info G ON G.EXCP_GROUP_SN=M.EXCP_GROUP_SN AND G.USE_YN='Y' JOIN web_dsblty_excp_schdl_info X ON X.EXCP_GROUP_SN=G.EXCP_GROUP_SN AND X.USE_YN='Y' WHERE M.EMS_ID=D.ems_id AND M.DEVICE_ID=D.device_id AND NOW() >= X.BGNG_DT AND (X.NO_END_YN='Y' OR X.END_DT IS NULL OR NOW() <= X.END_DT) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_dsblty_excp_schdl_grd_rel R WHERE R.EXCP_SCHDL_SN=X.EXCP_SCHDL_SN) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_dsblty_excp_schdl_grd_rel R WHERE R.EXCP_SCHDL_SN=X.EXCP_SCHDL_SN AND R.DSBLTY_GRD_CD=CASE D.event_grade WHEN '1' THEN 'EMERGENCY' WHEN '2' THEN 'HIGH' WHEN '3' THEN 'LOW' WHEN '4' THEN 'WARNING' WHEN '5' THEN 'INFO' END)) AND ( X.REPT_CYCLE_CN='ONCE' OR (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|%' AND (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|DAILY|%' OR (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|WEEKLY|%' AND FIND_IN_SET(ELT(WEEKDAY(NOW())+1,'MON','TUE','WED','THU','FRI','SAT','SUN'), SUBSTRING_INDEX(X.REPT_CYCLE_CN,'|',-1)) > 0) OR (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|MONTHLY|%' AND DAYOFMONTH(NOW())=DAYOFMONTH(X.BGNG_DT))) AND (X.REPT_START_TM IS NULL OR X.REPT_END_TM IS NULL OR (X.REPT_START_TM <= X.REPT_END_TM AND TIME(NOW()) BETWEEN X.REPT_START_TM AND X.REPT_END_TM) OR (X.REPT_START_TM > X.REPT_END_TM AND (TIME(NOW()) >= X.REPT_START_TM OR TIME(NOW()) <= X.REPT_END_TM))))) )

AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM web_dsblty_excp_group_eqpmnt_rel M JOIN web_dsblty_excp_group_info G ON G.EXCP_GROUP_SN=M.EXCP_GROUP_SN AND G.USE_YN='Y' JOIN web_dsblty_excp_schdl_info X ON X.EXCP_GROUP_SN=G.EXCP_GROUP_SN AND X.USE_YN='Y' WHERE M.EMS_ID=D.ems_id AND M.DEVICE_ID=D.device_id AND D.event_dt >= X.BGNG_DT AND (X.NO_END_YN='Y' OR X.END_DT IS NULL OR D.event_dt <= X.END_DT) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_dsblty_excp_schdl_grd_rel R WHERE R.EXCP_SCHDL_SN=X.EXCP_SCHDL_SN) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_dsblty_excp_schdl_grd_rel R WHERE R.EXCP_SCHDL_SN=X.EXCP_SCHDL_SN AND R.DSBLTY_GRD_CD=CASE D.event_grade WHEN '1' THEN 'EMERGENCY' WHEN '2' THEN 'HIGH' WHEN '3' THEN 'LOW' WHEN '4' THEN 'WARNING' WHEN '5' THEN 'INFO' END)) AND ( X.REPT_CYCLE_CN='ONCE' OR (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|%' AND (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|DAILY|%' OR (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|WEEKLY|%' AND FIND_IN_SET(ELT(WEEKDAY(D.event_dt)+1,'MON','TUE','WED','THU','FRI','SAT','SUN'), SUBSTRING_INDEX(X.REPT_CYCLE_CN,'|',-1)) > 0) OR (X.REPT_CYCLE_CN LIKE 'REPEAT|MONTHLY|%' AND DAYOFMONTH(D.event_dt)=DAYOFMONTH(X.BGNG_DT))) AND (X.REPT_START_TM IS NULL OR X.REPT_END_TM IS NULL OR (X.REPT_START_TM <= X.REPT_END_TM AND TIME(D.event_dt) BETWEEN X.REPT_START_TM AND X.REPT_END_TM) OR (X.REPT_START_TM > X.REPT_END_TM AND (TIME(D.event_dt) >= X.REPT_START_TM OR TIME(D.event_dt) <= X.REPT_END_TM))))) )
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(D.event_grade='1'),0) AS emergencyCount, COALESCE(SUM(D.event_grade='2'),0) AS highCount, COALESCE(SUM(D.event_grade='3'),0) AS lowCount, COALESCE(SUM(D.event_grade='4'),0) AS warningCount, COALESCE(SUM(D.event_grade='5'),0) AS infoCount FROM raw_event_action D WHERE D.event_yn=1 AND D.event_grade IN ('1','2','3','4','5')
AND D.ems_id IN #{id}

SELECT , D.event_edt AS dsbltyEndDt FROM raw_event_log D WHERE 1=1 AND D.ems_id IN #{id} AND D.event_dt >= CONCAT(#{startDt},' 00:00:00') AND D.event_dt < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{endDt},' 00:00:00'),INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY D.event_dt DESC,D.event_seq DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT D.event_seq AS actnSn,D.action_dt AS actnDt, D.event_symptom AS symptom,D.event_cause AS reason,D.action_text AS actnCn, D.action_plan AS plan,D.action_handler AS actorName,'GATEWAY' AS actnSeCd FROM raw_event_action D WHERE D.event_seq=#{eventSeq} AND D.action_dt IS NOT NULL AND D.ems_id IN #{id}

SELECT CASE C.GW_CD WHEN '1' THEN 'EMERGENCY' WHEN '2' THEN 'HIGH' WHEN '3' THEN 'LOW' WHEN '4' THEN 'WARNING' WHEN '5' THEN 'INFO' ELSE 'CLEAR' END AS code, C.COM_CD_NM AS name, C.GW_CD AS gwCd FROM com_cd_info C WHERE C.COM_CD_GROUP_ID='CD_FALT' AND C.GW_SRC_COL='event_grade' AND C.COM_CD_USE_YN='Y' AND C.GW_CD IN ('1','2','3','4','5') ORDER BY CAST(C.GW_CD AS UNSIGNED)

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(R.reg_dt,'%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS clctDt, '1시간 통계' AS dataTypeNm, DATE(R.reg_dt) AS clctDt, '1일 통계' AS dataTypeNm, R.reg_dt AS clctDt, 'Raw Data' AS dataTypeNm,
D.ems_id AS emsId, D.device_id AS gatewayDeviceId, CASE D.ems_id WHEN 1 THEN 'EMS_TX' WHEN 4 THEN 'VMS' WHEN 11 THEN 'PBX' WHEN 13 THEN 'EMS_PIDS' WHEN 16 THEN 'SCADA_SEC' END AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, S.STN_NM AS stnNm,D.device_nm AS eqpmntNm,D.device_id AS eqpmntMngNo, ROUND(AVG(R.cpu_usage),2) AS cpuUsgrt, ROUND(AVG(R.memory_usage),2) AS mmryUsgrt, ROUND(AVG(R.disk_usage),2) AS diskUsgrt FROM raw_usage_log R JOIN com_device_info D ON D.ems_id=R.ems_id AND D.device_id=R.device_id AND D.use_yn='Y' LEFT JOIN com_stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=D.stn_cd LEFT JOIN web_link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=CASE D.ems_id WHEN 1 THEN 'EMS_TX' WHEN 4 THEN 'VMS' WHEN 11 THEN 'PBX' WHEN 13 THEN 'EMS_PIDS' WHEN 16 THEN 'SCADA_SEC' END WHERE D.ems_id IN #{id} AND D.ems_id=CASE #{linkSysCd} WHEN 'EMS_TX' THEN 1 WHEN 'VMS' THEN 4 WHEN 'PBX' THEN 11 WHEN 'EMS_PIDS' THEN 13 WHEN 'SCADA_SEC' THEN 16 ELSE -1 END AND D.stn_cd=#{stnCd} AND R.reg_dt >= #{startDt} AND R.reg_dt <= #{endDt} AND (D.device_nm LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR D.device_id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR D.device_ip LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) GROUP BY
DATE_FORMAT(R.reg_dt,'%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'), DATE(R.reg_dt), R.usage_seq, R.reg_dt,
D.ems_id,D.device_id,D.device_nm,L.LINK_SYS_NM,S.STN_NM ORDER BY clctDt DESC LIMIT 500
